steering_coefficient_sweep.details: Real sweep with target+capability logged at every dose; narrow span (8x, not >=3 orders of magnitude); no sigma_proj scaling; no established plateau (valid-ORF drops ~26% relative at alpha=16); no random-direction control within this variant. Not FAIL: no hardcoded single alpha, no capability-blind metric, and critically this variant never anchors a headline number at a capability-degraded dose (unlike the main experiment's alpha*=32 or C3's alpha=16 decisive-dose FAIL pattern) -- its own question is trend agreement between two SS-assignment algorithms, which it answers regardless of where any single alpha sits.
